evidence: Adds thread CPU timing primitives in src/util/time.h and src/util/time.cpp (+100 lines).
rationale: The PR introduces reusable cross-platform per-thread CPU timing utilities in `src/util/time.{h,cpp}` using `clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID)` on POSIX and `GetThreadTimes()` on Windows. While providing a well-defined utility for timing thread execution, it is an incremental addition to support diagnostic reporting and is deferrable.
